claim: The 2025 Michelin Guide Vietnam awarded 63 Bib Gourmand selections across Hanoi, HCMC and Da Nang, with HCMC carrying 24 entries — the most of any city in Vietnam.
quote: Ho Chi Minh City stands out with 24 entries, making it the city with the most eateries on the list... 9 One MICHELIN Star (1 new, 1 promoted), 2 MICHELIN Green Star (1 new), and 63 Bib Gourmand (9 new).

claim: Com Tam Ba Ghien in Phu Nhuan District holds the Michelin Bib Gourmand and is known for an oversized grilled pork chop on broken rice at around 70,000 VND.
quote: Com Tam Ba Ghien — Location: Phu Nhuan District — Specialty: 'Giant pork rice' with oversized pork portion — Price: ~VND 70,000

claim: Banh Xeo 46A on Dinh Cong Trang Street is a Bib Gourmand snack spot whose crispy sizzling crepes follow a recipe passed through four generations.
quote: Banh Xeo 46A — Location: Dinh Cong Trang Street — Specialty: Crispy pancakes with secret recipe passed through four generations

claim: Pho Minh, a takeaway pho stall in a Pasteur alley near Park Hyatt, is a Bib Gourmand entry over 80 years old that sells out by 10 AM.
quote: Pho Minh — Location: Pasteur Street alley (near The Myst and Park Hyatt) — Specialty: Northern-style pho with Southern seasoning adjustments — Note: Over 80 years old, primarily takeaway, sells out by 10 AM

claim: Hu Tieu Hong Phat in District 3 earned Bib Gourmand status for Hu tieu Nam Vang featuring pork blood.
quote: Hu tieu Hong Phat — Location: District 3 — Specialty: Hu tieu Nam Vang with unique addition of pork blood — Note: Family-run, has branch in Vancouver

claim: Banh Mi Huynh Hoa at 26 Le Thi Rieng, District 1, sells a heavily-loaded sandwich (pate, pork sausages, char siu, mayo, chili) for ~65,000 VND and runs near-permanent queues 6am-10pm.
quote: 26 Đ. Lê Thị Riêng, Phường Phạm Ngũ Lão, Quận 1... 6am – 10pm (Mon – Sun)... pâté, pork sausages, and char siu pork... Regardless of the time of day, the lines seem to be a permanent fixture.

claim: Vietnam Coracle's local-pick banh mi guide recommends Banh Mi Sau Minh at 170 Vo Van Tan, District 3 — open 24 hours, a useful late-night option after dinner.
quote: Bánh Mì Sáu Minh — Location: 170 Võ Văn Tần, District 3 — Hours: 24 hours... Serving fresh bánh mì for almost half a century, the bread at Sáu Minh is crispy on the outside

claim: Vietnam Coracle pushes back on the algorithmic banh mi tourist trail, arguing locals stick to their neighbourhood stall rather than the queued-up famous names.
quote: no Ho Chi Minh City local would pay attention to endless 'best' bánh mì lists online. Instead, most bánh mì-loving citizens have their favourite, local, go-to place

claim: Pho Hoa Pasteur is a Michelin Bib Gourmand pho institution operating since 1968 on Pasteur Street in District 3, with a clean star-anise and cinnamon-balanced beef broth.
quote: Pho Hoa is a MICHELIN Bib Gourmand recipient that has been serving its meticulously crafted broth to Saigonese locals since 1968... whispers of star anise and cinnamon complementing rather than dominating

claim: The Michelin Guide frames Vietnamese coffee as a core cultural lens — from phin-drip robusta to egg, coconut, and salt coffee variants.
Salt coffee (ca phe muoi) originated in Hue around 2010 and has spread to Saigon as a sweet-salty robusta drink balancing bitterness with a salted-caramel-like finish.
quote: Salt coffee was created in Hue around 2010 by a couple — Mr. Phong and Mrs. Huong — at a small cafe on Nguyen Luong Bang Street called Ca Phe Muoi.

claim: For egg coffee (ca phe trung) in Saigon, Tonkin Coffee runs three District 1 cafes (Ly Tu Trong, Le Thi Rieng, Tran Hung Dao) with prices under 50,000 VND per cup.
quote: Tonkin Specialty Coffee at 91 Ly Tu Trong St... Tonkin Egg Coffee at 1 Le Thi Rieng... Tonkin keeps prices accessible—under 50,000 VND (~$2 USD) for most egg coffee variants.

claim: XO Tours, the all-female ao-dai Vespa operator running since 2010, holds a 5.0 rating over 7,558 reviews and its 'Foodie' tour was named a top food tour by Forbes — strong fit for a Friday-night street eats anchor before Saturday's Michelin dinner.
quote: Operating since 2010, it ranks #1 among 1,611 tours in the city with a perfect 5.0 rating across 7,558 reviews... XO Foodie tour earned recognition as one of the world's top food tours by Forbes.

claim: Banh Mi Bay Ho is a near-century-old District 1 stall serving traditional homemade pate, pork floss and 'vintage Saigon' flavour — a quieter counterpoint to Huynh Hoa's queues.
quote: Banh Mi Bay Ho — Operating for nearly a century, Bay Ho delivers traditional banh mi with homemade pate, pork floss, and a vintage Saigon flavor—a historical taste of Vietnam.

claim: Pho Le and Pho Quynh round out the Saigon pho shortlist: Pho Le for clean sweet broth with fresh herbs, Pho Quynh near Pham Ngu Lao for its signature Pho Bo Kho beef-stew bowl.
quote: Pho Quynh is packed out all day... The dish to try here is the Pho Bo Kho, or pho with beef stew – a gravy-like soup with hunks of beef and carrots
